sloka: हा पश्चिमा मे सम्प्राप्ता दशा वैधव्यकारिणी ।या मया ऽ ऽसीन्न सम्बुद्धा कदाचिदपि मन्दया ।। ६.११४.३९ ।।
transliteration: hā paścimā me samprāptā daśā vaidhavyakāriṇī ।yā mayā ' 'sīnna sambuddhā kadācidapi mandayā ।। 6.114.39 ।।

translations.english: "Ha! You are dead. I am widowed. I am foolish as I never thought that this stage will come."
